title: Clean IP Test Mode
summary: Test depth that Find Clean IP for a Config asks for before scanning the candidate IP list.

items.title: Basic TCP only
items.description: Opens a TCP connection to each candidate on the config port and measures rough latency.
items.usage_tip: Fastest option and the default; good for a first pass.

items.title: Advanced (Xray/Sing-box aware)
items.description: Core-aware test that currently falls back to the basic TCP check.
items.usage_tip: Still a placeholder, so results match Basic mode for now.
